office: Director, Florida Division of Emergency Management (appointed)

window.startNote: Appointed by Gov. DeSantis in January 2019; his Florida House seat ended 2019-01-11 (Florida House roster). No FDEM record giving his first day as director was found.
window.endNote: Worked through April 2021; FDEM announced Kevin Guthrie as director on May 3, 2021 (floridadisaster.org/news-media/news/20210503-...). Exact last day not stated there.

donors: None: an appointed post has no campaign or committee of its own. No gifts are matched for this office.
universe: Every FDEM news release dated 2019-01-08 to 2021-04-30 on floridadisaster.org (539 releases; raw/fdem-releases-2019-2021.json), read for FDEM actions naming a private party. Most releases are Governor or DOH announcements. No release states an FDEM contract award, purchase order or payment to a named vendor; those records are in FACTS (Executive Office of the Governor, agency 310000) and were not reachable without a browser.

actions.title: Governor Ron DeSantis Announces COVID-19 Vaccination Site at Florida Memorial University
actions.summary: FDEM opens a permanent COVID-19 vaccine site at Florida Memorial University (200 Moderna doses a day). No contract or payment stated.
actions.note: Named in an FDEM release, but the release states no contract, purchase or payment; the matching FDEM purchase orders and contracts are in FACTS (needs-browser.md 3g-3i).

actions.title: State of Florida Provides 9,000 Doses of COVID-19 Vaccine to AIDS Healthcare Foundation for Vulnerable Populations
actions.summary: FDEM and FDOH provide 9,000 COVID-19 vaccine doses to AIDS Healthcare Foundation to vaccinate people living with HIV. Doses, not money; no contract stated.
actions.note: Named in an FDEM release, but the release states no contract, purchase or payment; the matching FDEM purchase orders and contracts are in FACTS (needs-browser.md 3g-3i).

actions.title: Governor Ron DeSantis Announces Miami Hard Rock Stadium is Opening as the First State-Supported Vaccination and Testing Site
actions.summary: State-operated drive-thru vaccination and testing site opens at Hard Rock Stadium. Terms of use of the stadium not stated.
actions.note: Named in an FDEM release, but the release states no contract, purchase or payment; the matching FDEM purchase orders and contracts are in FACTS (needs-browser.md 3g-3i).

actions.title: Governor Ron DeSantis Announces Partnership with Publix to Open COVID-19 Vaccination Sites

actions.note: Named in an FDEM release, but the release states no contract, purchase or payment; the matching FDEM purchase orders and contracts are in FACTS (needs-browser.md 3g-3i).
